Thank you for doing this. A general comment

Create a suite Tag name from the test file name
Example:
    Suite:  test_boot_progress_code.robot

    Test Tags    Boot_Progress_Code

Reference: https://github.com/openbmc/openbmc-test-automation/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md

Please follow the same for all the file changes for Test Tags

@sridevra@in.ibm.com As @gkeishin@gmail.com suggested, I followed this example from https://github.com/openbmc/openbmc-test-automation/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md
```
Create a suite Tag name from the test file name
Example:
    Suite:  test_boot_progress_code.robot

    Test Tags    Boot_Progress_Code
```

I did that here - for test_ssl suite the tag is SSL. Is there a reason why you suggest to use Test_SSL instead the schema suggested in the CONTRIBUTING.md?
thats right. But SSL looks more like an abbreviation thats why suggested as Test_SSL
Fair enough. Let me change this.
